## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title follows Conventional Commits, for example `fix(safe-download): reject empty names`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests, and `pnpm -r test` and/or `cargo test` pass locally.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass (Rust changes).
- [ ] `pnpm -r build` passes (TypeScript changes).
- [ ] I updated docs and doc comments where behaviour changed.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets, personal data or references to private systems.
